이 포지션에 합격해 입사하시면 리멤버에서 합격 보상금 50만원을 드립니다
이 포지션 한눈에 보기 by AI
노트북·데스크탑 전문 라인의 쿠팡·네이버 등 이커머스 채널 매출 책임
채널별 리스팅·가격·프로모션·재고를 직접 운영하며 월간 목표 달성
쿠팡윙·스마트스토어 실무 경험과 MD 협상·매출 분석 역량 보유자 적합
You will own day-to-day sales performance on assigned channels, from listings and pricing to promotions and marketplace relationships, and turn sales data into decisions that raise revenue and margin. You will be handling Expert line products including notebooks and desktops.
주요업무
Key responsibilities
• Channel sales ownership: Manage sales, inventory and listings for assigned products on Coupang, Naver Smart Store, Gmarket, 11st or other e-commerce platform, and hit monthly and quarterly revenue targets.
• Pricing and promotions: Set and adjust pricing, plan campaigns around Korean e-retail peaks, and negotiate promotion slots with marketplace MDs.
• Listing quality: Maintain product pages, titles, images, specs and keywords in Korean so they rank well in marketplace search and convert.
• Forecasting and inventory: Work with product manager to forecast demand, plan stock, and avoid stock-outs and aged inventory.
• Advertising: Work with marketing team to run and optimize marketplace ads on e-commerce platform against ROAS targets in coordination with the marketing team.
• Reporting and analysis: Track sales, traffic, conversion, ranking, reviews and competitor pricing; deliver weekly and monthly reports with clear actions.
• Partner and customer management: Coordinate with distributors, marketplace sellers and customer support to resolve order, return and review issues quickly.
• Cross-team collaboration: Relay local market feedback to product, marketing and regional teams, and ensure launches are ready on every channel on day one.
자격 요건
Requirements
• 3-5 years of online sales, e-commerce or category management experience in Korea, ideally in consumer electronics, IT or gaming products.
• Hands-on experience with Coupang Wing, Naver Smart Store Center and at least one other Korean marketplace seller portal.
• Working knowledge of pricing, margin and promotion economics, and comfort building sales forecasts and reports in Excel or Google Sheets.
• Strong negotiation and relationship skills with marketplace MDs and distributors.
• Fluent Korean (native level) and business-level English for working with regional and global teams.
• Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
우대사항
Preferred
• Experience with Coupang or Naver fulfilment programs, and with live commerce
• Existing relationships with Korean marketplace category teams.
채용절차
1. 서류 전형
2. 1차 면접 (Logic Test + 면접)
3. 2차 면접
4. 최종합격
